name: Delete folder lock
description: Delete folder lock Deletes a folder lock on a given folder. DELETE /2.0/folder_locks/{folder_lock_id}

name: List folder locks
description: List folder locks Retrieves folder lock details for a given folder. GET /2.0/folder_locks
context:
GET /2.0/folder_locks
Retrieves folder lock details for a given folder. You must be authenticated as the owner or co-owner of the folder to use this endpoint.
Required: folder_id (query) — The unique identifier that represent a folder. The ID for any folder can be determined by visiting this folder in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folder/123` the `folder_id` is `123`. The root folder of a Box account is always represented by the ID `0`.

name: Create folder lock
description: Create folder lock Creates a folder lock on a folder, preventing it from being moved and/or deleted. POST /2.0/folder_locks
context:
POST /2.0/folder_locks
Creates a folder lock on a folder, preventing it from being moved and/or deleted. You must be authenticated as the owner or co-owner of the folder to use this endpoint.
Optional: body (body)
